inkStudio.label: Visuals
inkStudio.intro: Paper, colour and a little motion. Make this view your own.
inkStudio.autoBody: Auto uses simulation on capable desktops and animation elsewhere. Sustained slow frames simplify the rendering.
inkStudio.lightBody: Flowing shapes that respond to you. Less processing, fixed detail level.
inkStudio.fullBody: Physical swirls that follow your pointer. Uses more graphics power.
inkStudio.reducedNotice: Auto now uses Animation with fewer details to keep the page fluid.
inkStudio.reducedMotion: Your system's reduced motion setting is active. You can still choose colours.
inkStudio.unavailable: This ink view is currently unavailable on your device. Colours and content remain accessible.

inkPreview.label: Ink lab · local preview
inkPreview.autoBody: We reduced the effects automatically. You can still turn on the full ink simulation, though it may stutter.
inkPreview.lightBody: The ink moves and responds to you with less processing. Try both versions here.
inkPreview.fullBody: The full ink simulation is running. If it stutters, you can switch to the lighter version at any time.
inkPreview.unavailableTitle: The ink is taking a break.
inkPreview.unavailableBody: Reduced motion or unavailable graphics support takes priority. All content remains available.
